beats.speaker: scripture
beats.text: And when they were come to the place, which is called Calvary, there they crucified him, and the malefactors, one on the right hand, and the other on the left.

timing.text: And when they were come to the place, which is called Calvary, there they crucified him, and the malefactors, one on the right hand, and the other on the left.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: They brought him to a place called Calvary, and there they crucified him — between two criminals, at the hands of soldiers just following orders.

timing.text: They brought him to a place called Calvary, and there they crucified him — between two criminals, at the hands of soldiers just following orders.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: He had every reason to curse them. Every right to call down judgment.

timing.text: He had every reason to curse them.
Every right to call down judgment.

beats.speaker: scripture
beats.text: And they parted his raiment, and cast lots.

timing.text: And they parted his raiment, and cast lots.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: While he hung there, the soldiers divided up his clothes and threw dice for them, right at the foot of the cross. That is what was going on underneath him.

timing.text: While he hung there, the soldiers divided up his clothes and threw dice for them, right at the foot of the cross.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: And instead of a curse, the first words out of his mouth on the cross were a prayer — for the very people driving the nails.

timing.text: And instead of a curse, the first words out of his mouth on the cross were a prayer — for the very people driving the nails.

beats.speaker: jesus
beats.text: Father, forgive them; for they know not what they do.

timing.text: Father, forgive them; for they know not what they do.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Not, forgive them later, if they're sorry. Forgive them now — while it's still happening.

timing.text: Not, forgive them later, if they're sorry.
Forgive them now — while it's still happening.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: That is how far his mercy reaches. If it covered the ones killing him,

If it covered the ones killing him,

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: there is no one, and nothing you've done, it can't cover.

card.text: His first words on the cross were mercy for the ones who put him there. That mercy has your name in it too.
